strategy_statement: CS2 (and some Dota 2) in-play bot; from 10-16 a buy-only two-sided maker plus an informed taker, before that a round-trip taker in GRID tier-1/2 events that traded late (into moves already under way). [VALIDATE-only] Selection: whole events (match + all maps) of non-GRID tier-3/4 leagues, never an event with a GRID series id (0/122), favouring popular events and those the informed pack also trades; event rule AUC 0.954 vs activity 0.892. [VALIDATE-only] Maker: whole-cent 100-share BUY ladders near the best bid on both outcome tokens from game start, never sells, merges pairs (97% paired, pair cost 0.978), holds the residual; at its own takes it pulls its complement ladder within 11-19 ms (90% of takes) and re-posts it ~1.04 s later, when its FAK returns, so slower informed takers fill it. A public tape-based copy of this ladder with queue priority gets the same volume but loses 4-5%: the margin needs the live book. [hypothesis, live dev block] Taker: on in-round game events of a private feed it sends FAK BUYs of the team that gained (map and match legs within 1-4 ms) at the stale ask plus a premium that scales with the event's price impact (wallet-specific) and is propagated to the match leg at the series sensitivity; on the CLOB server clock nothing public precedes it (books of the match / map markets; round-market takers only follow), some fast makers cancel within ~10 ms of it on the same event (one named: 0x51dbdd2b, a maker with nearly the wallet's event selection), the pack signs 0.2-0.5 s later, and its order matches 1.04 s after signing. Per map, its take shares follow round wins and bomb plants, not opening kills. [VALIDATE-only] Economics: locked pair margins and rebates plus the informed taker legs; a generic public-data ladder in the same markets loses 5-10%.

selection.description: Whole events of non-GRID CS2 leagues (never a GRID event: 0/122), a subset of the events the informed pack covers; event logistic (league rate with GRID zeroing + pre-game popularity) AUC 0.954 vs activity 0.892 (gain +0.062, p 0.002), recall 0.72 at lift 3.3. An organiser-level official-data-holder flag is falsified (PGL: Oddin.gg holder, 9/13 traded).

timing.description: Taker: at in-round events of an unobserved feed; on the server clock it signs before every public trace (CS2 match / map books; round-market takers only follow it: 0.9% before vs 6.7% after). It pulls its own complement ladder in 90% of takes at +11/+14/+19 ms; 17-20% of takes see other makers' cancels between its signing and its pull (54x the base rate; one of them, 0x51dbdd2b, trades 69% of the wallet's events vs 12% of skipped non-GRID ones and never leads it); ~20-35% more attempts than fills (zero-fill FAKs). Before 10-16 its trades were late (+2.9c pre-move in GRID), from 10-16 it moves first. Maker: quotes from game start; re-posts the complement ~1.04 s after its takes (VALIDATE-only).

side.description: Maker: both outcomes (VALIDATE-only). Taker: the team that gained in-round; per-map take shares follow round wins and bomb plants (corr 0.38, p 0.06), not opening kills (p 0.44 beyond wins); it buys the T side in 54% of take events (p 0.13), while the pack P4e buys the CT side in 59% (p 6e-10).

price.description: Maker: whole-cent BUYs near the bid (filled orders vs the live full-book bid 52.6% within tick, vs others' bid 45.6%; 41.5% above others' bid by fill selection; last-print anchor 0.305 on VALIDATE). Taker: limit = stale ask + a premium that grows with the event (wallet-specific Spearman 0.26 with the 10-s move), kept 2-5c below the 60-120 s price; match-leg premium = map-leg premium x series sensitivity (~0.5). Controlled OLS: +0.82 / +0.87c of 10-s move per 1c of premium (p 9e-7 / 7e-11); at 3+c premium 79-83% of takes see a >= 4c favourable move within 60 s vs 53% at 0c.

size.description: Maker 100 shares in CS2 (inventory-scaled 54/58/68 seen in its pulls), 10 in Dota 2. Taker: about 0.3x of the pre-event depth up to its limit; fills ~98% of what the wave leaves; 1000/2000 caps fading. Taker size grows weakly with its premium (Spearman 0.22 BUILD / 0.14 VALIDATE), i.e. with its own estimate of the event.

exit.description: Never sells; pulls the complement ladder at its takes and re-posts it ~1.04 s later (slower informed takers fill it); merges pairs (pair cost 0.978) and holds the residual. A public tape-based ladder with queue priority gets the same volume but a pair cost of 1.005 (loses 4-5%): the margin needs the live book.

X49.evidence: pull_attrib.json (39 takes, 10-31 14:50-18:00, server clock): its own pull (equal-size multi-level or 100-share cancels) follows 89.7% of its takes at +11 / +14 / +19 ms (p10 / p50 / p90), sizes 100 (19), 68 (8), 54 (7), 58 (1); remainders of its partly filled orders (calldata) attributed too (5 cancels). Others' first cancel relative to its own pull: p10 -37, p25 -6, p50 +10, p75 +89 ms. So the wallet is not the only fast leader: in about one take in five, another maker acts on the same event within ~10 ms of it (a shared upstream source), the rest follow its pull or the event later. The 11 cancels inside those windows (+3 to +14 ms, one at +34 ms; sizes 31.26, 168, 5, 45, 199, 180, 40.47, 46.75, 7.01, 60, 20): 168 = 100 + 68 is probably the wallet's own double level, so the share is 17-20% (6-7 of 35 takes); two others match orders of 0x51dbdd2b (a POLY_PROXY co-maker present in 2,185 of the wallet's 16-22 Oct txs; size 199 at 0.49 and a 40.47 remainder at 0.38), the rest are unfilled orders of unknown makers. Candidate co-subscriber: 0x51dbdd2b19427dc8e88bb15a4046a38d8427f9b3. Coverage of 0x51dbdd2b (cosub_coverage.json; its 16,571 TRADE rows 10-16..10-22: 61% CS2, 29% Dota 2): it traded 68.8% of the wallet's 77 traded CS2 events, 11.9% of the 185 non-GRID events the wallet skipped and 17.2% of 122 GRID events; signer EOA 0xdecd4b4c... (POLY_PROXY), not the wallet's owner. Its filled maker re-signs after the wallet's takes: complement 7.5x in 0-100 ms, bought team 7.5x in 100-500 ms, both 8-15x at 1.00-1.15 s. A second operator with nearly the wallet's event selection and its timing. Own-recorder timing of 0x51dbdd2b-sized cancels (cosub_timing.json; its non-generic sizes 300/60/258/268.3/...): of 896 such cancels in the wallet's take markets 0.11% are followed by a wallet take within 1 s and 1.23% are preceded by one (11x); around the 39 takes they fall at -640, +9, +11, +12, +13, +25, +56, +108 ... ms. So it never leads the wallet; in some takes it cancels +9-13 ms after the wallet signs, as fast as the wallet's own pull message (+11-14 ms), i.e. too early to be a reaction to it.

X51.evidence: grid_latency.json (decision proxy = block time - 2 s for every group): bet-on team vs its price 60 s before the decision: taker regime GRID (1,435 trades, 70 markets) +1.41c at -10 s, +2.86c at 0, +6.78c at +60 s; taker regime non-GRID (208, 15 markets) +0.97 / +2.04 / +5.62c; maker regime takes (1,629) -0.85 / -0.98 / +3.06c.
